appearance.identity: Three open tapered towers, looping braces and a domed gazebo rise over Rodia's narrow mosaic sculpture court.
appearance.master: Preserves the three principal lattices, mosaic-covered bases, gazebo and fountain, ship, house remnants and smaller sculpture. Fits the assembly and court to sampled viewer terrain.
appearance.browser: All four levels preserve the open tower cages, west loops, gazebo and masts. The street and close-up recipes keep continuous supports, curved wall panels and the colorful mosaic accents.

terrainReference.basis: The sampled datum meets the normalized model 0.305 m above its lowest foundation point.

geographic.groundContactBasis: The two fitted court planes follow the sampled viewer terrain. A shallow concrete edge reaches below grade around the perimeter.
geographic.notes: The state park parcel supplies the court outline and street-facing axis. PMTiles locate the park and adjacent East 107th Street. Preserve the host map buildings, streets and ground.

limitations: Mosaic variation and small ornament use shared surfaces and authored color geometry. Individual shards, shell patterns and framing bends are interpreted from photographs.
Internal sculpture positions are proportional. The modern security fence, amphitheater and arts center are outside the sculpture asset.
